div.head: II As 1.3
div.ab: Gif] mon ðeof on cwearterne gebringe, þæt he beo feowertig nihta þær inne, ⁊ hine man lyse ðænne ut mid hundtwelfti scill'; ⁊ ga seo mægð him on borh, þæt he æfre geswice.
Gif mon ðeof on carcerne gebringe, ðæt he beo XL nihta on carcerne, ⁊ hine mon ðonne lyse út mid CXX scll'; ⁊ ga sio mægþ him on borh, ðæt he æfre geswice.
Gif mon þeof on carcerne gebringe, þæt he beo XL nihta on carcerne, ⁊ hine mon lyse þonne ut mid CXX scill'; ⁊ gá seo mægð him on borh, þæt he æfre geswice.
Si fur ponatur in carcere, sit ibi XL noctibus et inde redimatur foras per CXX sol.; et eat cognatio eius in plegium, quod deinceps abstineat.
Gif mon ðeof on carcerne gebringe, ðæt he beo XL nihta on carcerne, ⁊ hine mon ðonne lyse út mid CXX scll'; ⁊ ga sio mægþ him on borh, ðæt he æfre geswice.

If a thief is put in prison, he shall remain there forty days, and then he may be released on payment of 120 shillings, but his relatives shall stand as surety that he shall cease for ever after [from thieving].

If a thief is put into prison, he is to be in prison 40 days, and he may then be redeemed with 120 shillings; and the kindred are to stand surety for him that he will desist for ever. 1 .. And if he steals after that, they are to pay for him with his wergild, or to bring him back there.

Wenn ein Dieb ins Gefängniss gebracht wird, sei er 40 Tage im Kerker (darin B), und dann kann er [beim König] durch 120 Schilling ausgelöst werden; und die Sippe gehe für ihn in Bürgschaft, dass er immer [vom Stehlen] ablasse.

If a thief is brought into prison, let him be 40 days in jail (in there, B), and then he can be redeemed [from the king] for 120 shillings; and let the kindred go surety for him that he will forever desist [from stealing].
